match.userMessage: One greyscale storyboard frame. Frozen in this action: Scarlett photographs the coral print on the paper cup, then caps the lipstick and tucks it into Mina’s jacket pocket. Framing: medium close-up, slightly above, The women’s faces and window reflection share the frame, with the check and coral-marked paper cup in the lower foreground. Placement only, not the pose: Mina has just handed the lipstick back, looking newly amused; the server’s check rests beside the cups. Camera, as one or two arrows: push-in, smooth. Characters: Scarlett, Woman, 27, A 27-year-old woman of average height, Black fitted turtleneck, black wool coat carried. Mina, Woman, Late 20s, A woman in her late 20s, Green utility jacket with a roomy pocket, simple. Server, Unspecified, 20s-50s, An adult diner server of average height, Simple diner service uniform: clean button-up shirt, dark. The bodies are frozen in that action: if someone sits, they are seated; if someone reaches, the arm is extended. One figure per character. Drawn as a storyboard artist's animatic frame: confident pencil line with flat grey marker tones, three or four values, greyscale only even where the description names a colour. Clear silhouettes, the set blocked in with simple shapes. Camera travel is one or two arrows. A rough pre-production drawing: not a finished illustration, not a photo, not a 3D render. The drawing fills the whole image edge to edge: no border, no frame line, no paper margin, no grid of panels.
